description.en: A gallery of mathematical curve based loading animations built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
description.zh: 基于优美数学参数曲线驱动的加载动画画廊：纯原生 HTML、CSS 与 JavaScript 实现，轻量零依赖。

content.en: Math Curve Loaders transforms pure mathematics into expressive, hypnotic loading indicators. Using lightweight vector mathematics in vanilla JavaScript and Canvas/SVG, the project visualizes classical parametric curves—such as Rhodonea rose curves, Lissajous figures, hypotrochoids, cardioids, and Fourier-style epicyclic paths. Visitors can adjust mathematical frequency and damping parameters in real time and export production-ready code snippets with mathematical formula annotations.
content.zh: Math Curve Loaders 将高深精妙的参数几何数学转化为兼具美感与催眠感的 UI 加载指示器。全项目基于纯原生 JS 与 Canvas/SVG 构建，生动演绎了玫瑰线（Rhodonea）、利萨茹图形（Lissajous）、内旋轮线（Hypotrochoid）、心脏线（Cardioid）及傅里叶本轮合成轨迹等经典力学与几何轨迹。支持在线交互式拖动参数滑块调节频次与阻尼，并可一键复制附带数学公式注释的独立代码片段。
